title: Accumulate counts under category keys
description: You inspect how a dictionary stores a running count for each category.

steps.description: You prepare category strings and an empty counts dictionary. The loop binds category to each string in turn.
You use the current category as a dictionary key. The two branches assign either an updated count or an initial count.

steps.question: Which variable supplies the key in both assignments?
steps.answer: category supplies the key in both branches. Each assignment stores its result under that current category.

steps.description: You print the completed dictionary after the loop. Its entries associate category names with counts, rather than storing a separate list for each category.
